product: Cantina AI (AI Video Pranks campaign — affiliatenetwork.com)
audience: TikTok/Reels viewers 18–34 who love prank content, reaction videos, and AI-generated weirdness
job: 30s short-form video — creator reacts to or sets up an AI-generated prank scenario. Casual, shot on phone, no polish needed. Designed for TikTok, Reels, Shorts.
voiceRef: Surprised, entertained, slightly chaotic — like showing a friend something insane you just found. Fast-paced delivery.
constraints: No price mentions. Hook must be a prank premise or reaction in first 2 seconds. Must feel organic not scripted. Under 100 words. End with a soft curiosity-hook CTA ('the AI did this on its own', 'I didn't expect this', etc). No direct selling.
successCriteria: Viewer wants to see what happens next after the first sentence. Includes one specific surprising detail. Ends with an open loop that drives comments or shares.
